status_note: fixed upstream in 30.30.0 ([#8889](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/8889), PR [#8892](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/pull/8892)); the repro matches DuckDB on 30.30.0.
summary: The tokenizer reads every underscore in a number as a digit separator. DuckDB reads only an underscore between two digits so; anywhere else it starts an alias.
repro: `SELECT 1__2` is 1 (named `__2`) in DuckDB, 12 in SQLGlot; `SELECT 1._5` is 1 (named `_5`), 1.5 in SQLGlot. `1_000` agrees.
handling: The lift refuses a number with an underscore not between two digits (`_check_numbers`).

checked.note: repro on 30.22.0, 30.29.0 (pure Python and sqlglotc) and main (pure Python)
